meta.notes: Enemy holding a settlement; no-strike structures adjacent.

tlog.msg: SKIRMISH: OCCUPIED SETTLEMENT — NO-STRIKE ADJACENT (NORMAL). Enemy element has occupied the village of FAVANGO — find it on your sheet by name. The huts are NO-STRIKE and the villagers are still in them: one round inside the settlement fails the mission, full stop. The occupiers hold the edge. Cut them off it.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "SAWMILL" grid 253 543 (grid brg 2579) · AB1002 "CHAPEL" grid 242 582 (grid brg 6281). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.

>>> THE JOB: Enemy element has occupied the village of FAVANGO — find it on your sheet by name. The huts are NO-STRIKE and the villagers are still in them: one round inside the settlement fails the mission, full stop. The occupiers hold the edge. Cut them off it.
NORTH OF THE VILLAGE OF FAVANGO, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
